text: 所有采购都需要财务审批。
evidence: 制度/采购审批制度.md: 无论金额大小，采购申请都须经财务部审批。
note: Finance approves purchases of any amount (无论 is not a negation); emergency purchases still complete approval afterwards. The wording is absolute even though the evidence backs it.

text: 超过 5 万元的采购还需要 CTO 签字。
note: The policy escalates purchases over 100k yuan to the VP, and 无需 CTO 签字 is about freeze releases; no passage states or excludes a CTO sign-off for purchases.

text: 提交采购申请时要附三家供应商的报价。
evidence: 制度/采购审批制度.md: 2万元及以下的采购无需比价
note: Three vendor quotes are required only above 20k yuan; purchases of 20k or less need no price comparison.

text: 代码合并前至少需要两人审查。
evidence: 制度/代码评审规范.md: 每个合并请求至少需要一名非作者的评审人批准
note: The general rule is one non-author approver; two are required only for payment and permission modules.

text: 改动支付模块的代码非得两个人评审通过才能合并。
evidence: 制度/代码评审规范.md: 每个合并请求至少需要一名非作者的评审人批准；涉及支付和权限模块的改动需要两名。
note: Payment-module changes need two approving reviewers (需要两名 refers back to 评审人批准); 非得…才 states a requirement, not a negation.

text: 新的代码评审规范执行得非常顺利。
note: The code review policy states rules effective 2026-08-01 but nothing reports how well they are followed; 非常 is an intensifier, not a negation.

text: 封版期间禁止任何上线。
evidence: 邮件/2026-09-26-国庆封版通知.txt: 期间仅允许 P0 级修复上线，由当周值班经理审批即可，无需 CTO 签字。
note: P0 fixes may still be released during the freeze (允许 vs 禁止). It also cannot hold together with the memory's rule for releasing during the freeze.

text: 封版期间上线不仅要是 P0 修复，而且要 CTO 审批。
evidence: 邮件/2026-09-26-国庆封版通知.txt: 期间仅允许 P0 级修复上线，由当周值班经理审批即可，无需 CTO 签字。
note: P0 fixes need only the on-duty manager's approval and explicitly no CTO sign-off; 不仅…而且 is not a negation. Conflicts with the claim that nothing may be released.

text: 2026年10月12日起恢复正常发布节奏。
note: The freeze ends 2026-10-08 10:00 and the post-freeze release schedule is to be announced; no date for resuming the normal cadence is given.

evidence: 会议纪要/2026-09-15-季度规划会.md: 第四季度前端岗位冻结招聘，后端新增2个名额。
note: Frontend hiring is frozen for Q4; the claim's 不 restates the freeze rather than contradicting it.

text: 后端新增的 2 个名额都给支付组。
note: The payment team asked for more people, but the allocation of the two new backend slots is left to the technical committee.

text: 远程办公的日子可以自己选，没有固定的到岗日。
evidence: 制度/远程办公制度.md: 自2026年7月1日起，员工每周可远程办公两天，周二和周四须到岗。
note: Tuesday and Thursday are fixed office days.

text: 2025年12月18日：2026年研发预算定为1200万元。
evidence: 会议纪要/2025-12-18-年度预算会.md: 2025年12月18日的年度预算会确定：2026年研发预算总额为1200万元，其中云资源费用不超过400万元。
note: True as a dated record of the 2025-12-18 decision even though 1.5M yuan was added later; its date is over 180 days before as_of.

evidence: 会议纪要/2026-09-15-季度规划会.md: 由于云资源费用超支，下半年研发预算追加150万元。
note: The 12M yuan budget set in December was topped up by 1.5M in September, so the 2026 total is 13.5M.

text: 2026年云资源费用的上限已经上调到 550 万元。
note: 400 + 150 is the memory's own arithmetic: the 1.5M top-up went to the overall R&D budget and no passage states a new cloud cap; the claim says the old 4M cap was raised, so that cap does not contradict it.

text: 云资源超支估计主要是 GPU 训练任务导致的。
evidence: 会议纪要/2026-09-15-季度规划会.md: 云资源超支的主要来源是日志存储和跨可用区流量。
note: The planning meeting names log storage and cross-AZ traffic as the main sources; the hedge does not make a different main cause compatible.

text: 未来一年内会把代码仓库从 GitLab 迁到自建 Gitea。
note: Code-hosting maintenance cost was raised but alternatives have not been discussed; 暂未讨论 decides nothing either way and 未来 is not a negation.
